web3.title: Web3 Accessibility
web3.description: Specialized accessibility patterns for Web3 applications including wallet connections and transactions.

bestPractices.title: Best Practices
do: Use semantic HTML elements (button, nav, main, etc.)
Provide descriptive aria-labels for interactive elements
Ensure minimum 44px touch targets on mobile
Provide alternative text for complex Web3 concepts
avoid: Using color alone to convey information
Creating keyboard traps without escape routes
Using generic labels like "Click here" or "Read more"
